7354.title: Cascade activity is omitted from archive confirmation
7354.rootCauseOneLine: Archive confirmation computes its stop-work warning only from selected threads, excluding cached running descendants in the archive cascade.
7354.proposedFix: Compute a stop-work flag from selected live threads and cached live cascade descendants, then pass it to the archive dialog.
7354.caveats: DOM regression reproduced twice; live provider cancellation was not run. Active work has a 30-second archive Undo grace. Screenshots blocked by missing Chrome host runtime libraries.
